title: Grab a Coffee: Future-Aware Guidance for Discrete Diffusion with Compiled Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2609.35924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by iteratively resolving multiple tokens in parallel, offering a flexible alternative to left-to-right generation. However, guiding this process with a sequence-level objective is difficult because the value of one unresolved token depends on the other tokens with which it can form a high-reward sequence. Enumerating all such completions makes the whole guidance computation grow exponentially with the number of unresolved positions. We introduce COFFEE, a plug-and-play framework that avoids this enumeration by separating sequence dependence from the objective. At each diffusion step, a target-free carrier absorbs the marginal token distributions predicted by the denoiser to construct a joint model over the unresolved tokens, while a compiled finite-state model records how their combinations affect the sequence-level preference. Pairing their states allows COFFEE to transfer global preferences

translated_title: 来杯咖啡（COFFEE）：基于编译目标的离散扩散未来感知引导
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型通过迭代地并行确定多个词元来生成序列，为从左到右的生成方式提供了一种灵活的替代方案。然而，使用序列级目标来引导这一过程十分困难，因为某个未确定词元的价值取决于它能与之共同构成高奖励序列的其他词元。枚举所有此类补全会使整个引导计算随未确定位置的数量呈指数级增长。我们提出了COFFEE，这是一个即插即用的框架，通过将序列依赖性与目标函数相分离来避免这种枚举。在每个扩散步骤中，一个无目标的载体吸收去噪器预测的边缘词元分布，从而在未确定词元上构建联合模型；同时，一个编译得到的有限状态模型记录这些词元的组合如何影响序列级偏好。将二者的状态配对，使COFFEE能够传递全局偏好……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: COFFEE是一个即插即用框架，通过将吸收边缘词元分布的无目标载体与编译的有限状态模型状态配对，避免了随未确定位置数指数级增长的枚举计算，从而实现对离散扩散生成过程的高效序列级引导。
en_tdlr: COFFEE is a plug-and-play framework that enables efficient sequence-level guidance for discrete diffusion by pairing a target-free carrier of marginal token distributions with a compiled finite-state model, avoiding exponential enumeration of possible completions.
